cli.services_help.services_description.note: Group-page definition of services: lop serve and supervised LaunchAgents, not conversation runtimes. Preserve restart keeping the serve daemon pid and socket. Command/product identifiers remain literal.

cli.services_help.status_description.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.services_help.status_description.note: status is read-only. Same-version rebuild drift must remain distinguishable; report both installed and actively served builds, not just version strings.

cli.services_help.restart.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.services_help.restart.note: restart moves services to the current build and never stops a conversation runtime.

cli.services_help.wait.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.services_help.wait.note: --wait is a positive per-daemon wait. {wait_seconds} is the preformatted g-style numeric DEFAULT_SERVICES_WAIT_S constant, not translatable prose; the catalogue owns the seconds suffix and default explanation. Preserve timeout behavior: report, keep old build serving, retry next restart.

cli.services_help.reclaim.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.services_help.reclaim.note: reclaim ends only a recorded lop serve daemon proven not to be serving its recorded address; never a serving daemon. Preserve the safety restriction.

cli.services_help.reclaim_description.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.services_help.reclaim_description.note: Recovery caveat: reclaim targets exactly one proven daemon pid, escalating SIGTERM to SIGKILL at a bound. It is never automatic because successor readiness cannot be proved from the record. Preserve commands, signal names and this restriction.

cli.services_help.pid.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.services_help.pid.note: reclaim positional pid must match the value printed by lop services status. Preserve pid and the command token.
